client_providers.label: Prospect source (optional automation)
client_providers.purpose: Finds eligible local businesses from a permitted data source.
clientProvides: Licensed directory or client-approved search/Maps API, local business niche, location, permitted-use terms
client_providers.secretDestination: Provider credential in client n8n Credentials; source/analyzer local demo needs no API key.
steps: Enter the city, niches, score threshold, and daily cap in config.json.
Supply one authorized public URL or approved prospect source.

client_providers.label: Website analyzer
client_providers.purpose: Scores mobile/responsive/site basics and extracts visible public business content.
clientProvides: Python 3 and an authorized public business website URL; the standalone scorer uses the Python standard library
client_providers.secretDestination: No key is required by the analyzer.
steps: Review the score and every extracted fact before preview generation.

client_providers.label: Optional AI/site generation + hosting
client_providers.purpose: Turns reviewed business facts into a watermarked preview website.
clientProvides: Approved site-generation tool/provider, hosting account or destination, owner permission to create/store the preview
client_providers.secretDestination: Provider credential in client vault; do not put it in outreach messages.
steps: Generate a preview using only reviewed facts and mark it “not the live site”.
Publish only with owner permission and a planned removal date.

client_providers.label: Optional CRM/email
client_providers.purpose: Stores a reviewed prospect/outreach draft; no email sends are wired in this kit.
clientProvides: CRM/list owner, sender name/email/business address, recipient jurisdiction, provider documentation and approved send policy
client_providers.secretDestination: Client’s n8n/email connector secure credential store only.
steps: Connect a prospect log and keep send/outreach nodes paused.
Have a person review recipient eligibility, jurisdiction, message, opt-out and address before sending.
